messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — Customer X wants a Q3 private pilot. Need to align runway: infra, runtime changes, security gating, and rough cost. Can we do a short async sync here?

alex: Can we get expected capacity? July is already congested on GPUs.

tomas: Runtime note: model quantization baseline required before we can sign off perf. That plus any kernel tweaks -> ~2w estimate until we can claim production perf.

leila: Infra can spin staging clusters but we need a ticket + cost approval. What size are we targeting (vCPU/GPU/memory)?

sam: Security: we'll need a KMS/HSM key path for customer keys + a light threat model for pilot. Full pen test is optional but will take weeks.

maya: Proposed minimal plan: M1) runtime evaluates and lands 8-bit quant baseline, M2) infra provisions 2-node GPU staging cluster, M3) security runs a light threat model + checklist in parallel. If everyone agrees I'll assemble a prelaunch checklist.

oliver: Add oncall/runbook items: canary rollout, automated healthchecks, circuit breakers, and a fast rollback path. Need explicit abort criteria.

alex: Engineering ETA rough: quant baseline 10d, integration + infra glue 5d, e2e + perf checks 3d -> ~18d dev path. If infra is late add a 1w buffer. Also need a dependency on the runtime kernel change Tomas mentioned.

leila: Created ticket INFRA-4210 for staging. Cost estimate attached in the ticket: ~$12k/month reserved. Finance approval needed by 2026-03-30 to lock discounts.

maya: Thanks. I'll ping finance/legal. @sam can you give an estimate for the light audit timeline so we can slot it?

sam: Light audit (threat model + checklist) ~5 business days. Formal pen test optional (3w+). For pilot we can do light audit and a scoped checklist.

tomas: Important: the batching kernel needs minor adjustments when we run the quantized model with KV-cache behavior. I'll scope and post a short RFC to ENG-RUNTIME tomorrow (tracking INF-RUN-333). If it's bigger than expected we'll fallback.

alex: Fallback option: use hosted model variant with lower concurrency (keeps pilot timeline but increases cost). Not ideal for SLA testing but works as contingency.

maya: :thumbsup: OK. Ask: everyone please ack blockers/reqs in this thread by EOD Friday. I'll consolidate into the prelaunch checklist and share in #product.

kate: I'll own the checklist doc and add rollout gates: security signoff, infra provisioned, performance within SLA, canary green. Will add tasks and owners.

oliver: Proposed SLO targets for pilot: p95 generation < 120ms (short prompts), p99 < 400ms. Also add token-rate throttles for burst protection.

maya: Good targets. Scheduling a 30m sync Friday 10:00am to finalize commitments — invite sent.

deploy-bot: Meeting created: "Pilot runway sync" Fri 10:00 — maya, alex, tomas, leila, sam, oliver, kate invited.

maya: Thanks all — I'll post the consolidated checklist after sync.
